title: Quiz: Structure of the Periodic Table

questions.stem: What is a 'group' in the periodic table?

options.text: A vertical column of elements with similar chemical properties
A set of elements with the same atomic mass

questions.explanation: A group is a vertical column in the periodic table. Elements in the same group have the same number of electrons in their outer shell and therefore show similar chemical properties.

questions.stem: What does the period number tell you about an element's electronic structure?

options.text: The number of electrons in the outer shell
The number of occupied electron shells
The number of protons in the nucleus

questions.explanation: The period number tells you how many electron shells (energy levels) the atom has. For example, elements in Period 3 have three occupied electron shells.

questions.stem: Where are metals generally found in the periodic table?

options.text: On the left-hand side and in the centre

questions.explanation: Metals are found on the left-hand side and in the centre of the periodic table. Non-metals are found on the right-hand side.

questions.stem: What does the group number tell you about an element (for main group elements)?

options.text: The number of electrons in the outer shell

questions.explanation: For main group elements, the group number equals the number of electrons in the outer shell. For example, Group 2 elements have 2 outer shell electrons.

questions.stem: An element is in Group 6 and Period 3. How many electron shells does it have, and how many electrons are in its outer shell?
questions.explanation: Period 3 means 3 electron shells. Group 6 means 6 electrons in the outer shell. This element is sulfur (2,8,6).

questions.stem: Why do elements in the same group have similar chemical properties?

options.text: They have the same number of protons
They have the same number of electrons in their outer shell
They have the same atomic mass
They were discovered at the same time

questions.explanation: Elements in the same group have the same number of outer shell electrons. Since chemical reactions involve outer shell electrons, these elements react in similar ways.

questions.stem: How many elements are in Period 2 of the periodic table?
questions.explanation: Period 2 contains 8 elements (lithium to neon). This is because the second electron shell can hold a maximum of 8 electrons.
